title: Vintage 1930 convertible! Old Montreal Tour-Private Guide -70 min
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

blurb:
Embrace Montreal’s beauty in the most charming way possible–retro vintage style! With the “caleches” now a thing of the past, this experience proudly takes the reins:

TOUR DESCRIPTION: 70 minutes - Feel the echoes of the past and discover the magic of OLD MONTREAL — its streets, its stories, and its timeless charm - with your private guide.

WHAT MAKES THIS EXPERIENCE SO SPECIAL?
- It’s the only one of its kind in Montreal
- Think magical moments, guaranteed smiles, and stories you’ll tell forever
- Not just for tourists - even locals fall under its spell
- The car? A rolling charm factory with vintage soul
- Perfect for 3 adults, or 2 adults and 2 children.
